title: 第14章  还钱！
slug: 穿成星际废雌捡漏sss级兽夫赢麻了
content_zh:
姜知夏抱着一大堆蛋糕盒子，一脸懵地站在门口。
送蛋糕的是个兔族少年，不知道什么原因脸颊泛着一层红润。
他羞涩地低着头，“公主殿下，这是大殿下吩咐送来的，以后每周都会调配不同口味的蛋糕送来，让您尝尝。”
姜知夏恍然大悟：大哥送的？
看不出来啊，冰山大哥居然还有心思细腻的一面。
皇室这一家，果然很宠原主。
她微微一笑：“谢谢，辛苦你了！”
少年脸颊更红了，小声应了句“没什么”，捂着心口离开。
呜呜公主真好看……到底谁在传公主娇纵跋扈的！明明很温柔啊！
姜知夏美滋滋把蛋糕分成两份，给陆决留三块，剩下的都归自己。
她没骗姜霆，自己真的喜欢吃甜食，上辈子当牛马的时候，甜食可是她唯一的慰藉！
陆决安静地坐在餐桌旁，望着她的方向。
他感觉自己的眼睛好像有所好转。
以前只能模糊地分辨出人形，现在却可以判断出雌性刚才所有的动作了。
只是依旧看不清楚。
“陆决，蛋糕我给你留三块，太甜了你不能总吃……”
他看着公主一边把蛋糕放进冰箱，一边对自己叮嘱。
想把眼睛的状况告诉她，刚动了动唇，门口突然传来动静。
“公主！你在不在家啊？”
两人同时扭头。

姜知夏目瞪口呆地看着大摇大摆走进来的曾雯雯。
啧，她怎么把这货有这栋别墅的进出权限给忘了？
原主当初把她当成唯一的朋友，几乎所有东西都和她共享。
曾雯雯一进门，立刻就看见了姜知夏和她身边坐着的陆决。
她的眼睛瞬间瞪大，“公主！你居然真的把这个垃圾带回家了？！”
她几步冲过来，好像姜知夏犯了什么大错，“你和这种东西接触，让白哥哥怎么想？！”
陆决在她靠近的瞬间，立刻站起来挡在姜知夏身前。
他本能地露出戒备的姿态。
姜知夏扶额。
全帝国，敢让公主为一个雄性守女德的，也就曾雯雯能干得出来。
曾雯雯见陆决还敢挡着自己，毫不客气抬手，“没规矩的东西！滚开！”
这一巴掌没落下来。
姜知夏攥住了她的手腕。
自己养了好几天的大狼狗，又乖又听话，她凭什么一见面就打？
一把甩开她，冷哼一声，“你敢对我的人动手动脚？”
曾雯雯被甩得踉跄一步，错愕抬头，“你说什么？你的人？”
陆决原本紧绷的身体悄悄放松了些，垂着头抿唇，眼底划过一丝笑意。
姜知夏以为他被吓到了，低声安抚他，“没事的，我来解决。”
曾雯雯一看她对陆决轻声细语，更不可置信了。
“公主！你没糊涂吧？一个罪奴你护着他干什么？你还真和这种肮脏的东西厮混在一起了？！”

“肮脏”两个字，和白知遇简直如出一辙。
姜知夏板着脸看向她，“曾雯雯，你再敢多说一个字就给我滚出去！”
说完她顿了一下，突然笑了：“不对，你还不能走。”
曾雯雯看她变脸，心里松了口气：她就知道，姜知夏离不开自己，她可是她唯一的朋友！
她扬了扬下巴，摆出一副说教的姿态：“公主，你刚才也太过分了吧？就算你现在道歉，我也不会轻易原谅你的。”
姜知夏：“……？”
曾雯雯自顾自继续说：“还有，我看你这次欲擒故纵的招数玩得太大了！你怎么能把正夫的位置给别人？就算你以后和白哥哥解释清楚，白哥哥也会生气的！他那么骄傲的人……”
陆决一愣。
这个陌生雌性口中的“白哥哥”，他猜到是前几天被自己丢出去的那个雄性。
可是……正夫？
曾雯雯还在喋喋不休：“白哥哥最近因为你吃了不少苦，肯定已经讨厌你了，更别说你还和罪奴走这么近！公主，你这样会永远失去他的！”
她说完，志在必得地看着姜知夏。
以往，只要她这么说，姜知夏就会对她百依百顺，讨好她让她出主意。
只是这一次，却和她想象的不同。
姜知夏嗤笑了一声，“那种软饭男，我失去他有什么好可惜的。”
应该是白知遇失去原主，那才叫可惜。
她笑盈盈地伸手，“先不说别的，说说你吧，你是来还钱的吗？”
天杀的，她居然把这事给忘了！
前段时间缺钱，曾雯雯没在自己面前出现过，她居然都没想起来。
这塑料姐妹前后从原主身上借走不少钱，拿走的衣服首饰个个价值不菲！

其实自从宴会之后，雌后大方的给她打了五百万零花钱，她已经不缺钱了。
但那是两码事！
欠钱不还，那是滔天大罪！
曾雯雯以为自己耳朵出问题了：“你……你说什么？”
姜知夏礼貌微笑：“还钱啊！我记得你一共借走我一百多万金币，还有你每次说临时借走的衣服首饰，你也知道，我从来不用别人用过的东西，所以都给我折现吧。”
她低头算了算，抬头笑得更灿烂了，“一共三百六十万金币哦～”
曾雯雯不可置信地指了指自己，说话都结巴了，“公，公主，我是你的朋友啊！”
姜知夏一听，表情比她还夸张：“我们不是绝交了吗？再说了，朋友就可以不还钱？”
曾雯雯脸色一阵青一阵白。
她终于意识到，姜知夏真的变了。
可是为什么？！明明几天前还好好的！
她猛地扭头，恶狠狠地瞪向陆决。
难道是因为他？！
她指着陆决，声音尖厉，“公主！是不是这个下贱货蛊惑了你？！你是公主啊！怎么能听一个奴隶的话？！”
姜知夏笑容一收，冷了脸。
陆决抬起眼，凶狠地朝她看过去。
曾雯雯被对方眼底的戾气吓了一跳。
这个罪奴还敢凶她？！
姜知夏语气冷了下来，“曾雯雯，你对他放尊重点，不然我就不是单纯让你还钱这么简单了。”
她说完注意到曾雯雯惊恐的表情，下意识回头。

陆决乖乖站在她身后，无辜地抬眼看向她，眼底一片迷茫。
姜知夏更生气了。
这俩狗东西一见面就是下贱，肮脏的骂！
孩子才多大，留下心理阴影怎么办？！
她凶巴巴扭回头：“还钱！不还的话，我就让大哥亲自去曾家，反正大哥现在就在皇宫，我一句话的事。”
曾雯雯脸色又白了几分。
如果姜霆出手……曾家就完蛋了！
她抖着手掏出光脑，艰难地说：“我，我现在没有这么多，只有这些……”
“叮——”
姜知夏看了眼光脑，到账一百万金币。
曾雯雯哪还有刚才趾高气扬的样子，可怜兮兮红着眼眶求饶：“这是我攒了好久才攒下来的，剩下的……”
她想说“剩下的就算了吧，公主肯定不缺这点小钱”。
姜知夏高高兴兴收款，应她：“嗯嗯剩下的分期也行，不过我只给你一个月时间哦，凑不够我可就不客气啦。”
曾雯雯惨白着脸，闭嘴了。
姜知夏拿到钱，抬手一指：“好了，你可以走了。”
曾雯雯气得抹着眼泪扭头就跑。
她哪还敢留下啊！
等人走了，姜知夏翘着脚在沙发上笑。
“哈哈哈爽啊！”做公主真好！
陆决走过来，在她身边蹲下。

“公主……选正夫了吗？”
content_en:
Jiang Zhixia stood at the door with a confused look on her face, holding a large pile of cake boxes.
The person who delivered the cake was a boy from the rabbit tribe, and his cheeks were rosy for some unknown reason.
He lowered his head shyly, "Your Highness, your Highness ordered this to be delivered. From now on, cakes with different flavors will be prepared and delivered every week for you to try."
Jiang Zhixia suddenly realized: Is it a gift from eldest brother?
I can’t tell, but Brother Bingshan actually has a delicate side.
The royal family really doted on the original owner.
She smiled slightly: "Thank you, thank you for your hard work!"
The boy's cheeks turned even redder, he whispered "It's nothing", and left holding his heart.
Princess Wuwu is so beautiful... Who is telling you that the princess is spoiled and domineering! It's obviously very gentle!
Jiang Zhixia happily divided the cake into two parts, leaving three pieces for Lu Jue and keeping the rest for herself.
She didn't lie to Jiang Ting. She really likes sweets. When she was a cow and horse in her previous life, sweets were her only comfort!
Lu Jue sat quietly at the dining table, looking in her direction.
He felt as if his eyes were getting better.
In the past, I could only vaguely distinguish the human form, but now I can judge all the movements of the female just now.
But I still can't see clearly.
"Lu Jue, I'll leave you three pieces of cake. It's too sweet and you can't always eat it..."
He watched the princess put the cake in the refrigerator and told himself.
I wanted to tell her about the condition of my eyes, but just as I moved my lips, there was a sudden movement at the door.
"Princess! Are you at home?"
They both turned their heads at the same time.
Jiang Zhixia stared blankly at Zeng Wenwen who walked in swaggeringly.
Gee, why did she forget that this guy has access rights to this villa?
The original owner initially regarded her as his only friend and shared almost everything with her.
As soon as Zeng Wenwen entered the door, she immediately saw Jiang Zhixia and Lu Jue sitting next to her.
Her eyes widened instantly, "Princess! You actually brought this garbage home?!"
She rushed over in a few steps, as if Jiang Zhixia had made a big mistake, "What does Brother Bai think when you come into contact with this kind of thing?!"
The moment she approached, Lu Jue immediately stood up and stood in front of Jiang Zhixia.
He instinctively showed a defensive posture.
Jiang Zhixia held up his forehead.
In the entire empire, Zeng Wenwen was the only one who dared to ask a princess to uphold female virtues for a male.
Seeing that Lu Jue still dared to block her, Zeng Wenwen raised her hand unceremoniously, "You unruly thing! Get away!"
The slap did not fall.
Jiang Zhixia grabbed her wrist.
She had raised a big wolfdog for several days, and he was so good and obedient. Why should she beat him whenever he saw him?
He threw her away and snorted coldly, "You dare to touch my people?"
Zeng Wenwen was thrown away and staggered, looking up in surprise, "What did you say? Your people?"
Lu Jue's originally tense body quietly relaxed a little, he lowered his head and pursed his lips, a smile flashed in his eyes.
Jiang Zhixia thought he was frightened, so she comforted him in a low voice, "It's okay, I'll take care of it."
Zeng Wenwen couldn't believe it when she saw her whispering to Lu Jue.
"Princess! Are you not confused? Why are you protecting a sin slave? Are you really hanging out with such a dirty thing?!"
The word "dirty" is exactly the same as Bai Zhiyu.
Jiang Zhixia looked at her with a straight face, "Zeng Wenwen, if you dare to say one more word, get out of here!"
After speaking, she paused and suddenly smiled: "No, you can't leave yet."
Seeing her change of expression, Zeng Wenwen felt relieved: She knew that Jiang Zhixia couldn't live without her, and she was her only friend!
She raised her chin and assumed a preaching posture: "Princess, did you go too far just now? Even if you apologize now, I will not forgive you easily."
Jiang Zhixia: "...?"
Zeng Wenwen continued to talk to herself: "Also, I think your hard-to-get trick is too much this time! How can you give up your position as husband to someone else?"people? Even if you explain it clearly to Brother Bai later, Brother Bai will still be angry! He is such a proud person..."
Lu Jue was stunned.
He guessed that the "Brother Bai" mentioned by this strange female was the male he had thrown out a few days ago.
But...the real husband?
Zeng Wenwen was still chattering: "Brother Bai has suffered a lot because of you recently, and he must already hate you, let alone you being so close to the sin slave! Princess, you will lose him forever! "
After she finished speaking, she looked at Jiang Zhixia with determination.
In the past, as long as she said this, Jiang Zhixia would be obedient to her, please her and let her give her ideas.
Only this time, it was different from what she imagined.
Jiang Zhixia sneered, "That kind of soft-boiled guy, why would it be a pity for me to lose him. "
It should be a pity that Bai Zhiyu lost his original owner.
She stretched out her hand with a smile, "Let's not talk about anything else. Let's talk about you. Are you here to pay back the money? "
Damn it, she actually forgot about this!
She was short of money some time ago, and Zeng Wenwen didn't appear in front of her, and she didn't even think of it.
This plastic sister borrowed a lot of money from the original owner, and the clothes and jewelry she took away were all valuable!
In fact, since the banquet, the female queen generously gave her five million in pocket money, and she was no longer short of money.
But that's two different things!
Not paying back the money you owe is a heinous crime!
Zeng Wenwen thought there was something wrong with her ears: "You...what did you say? "
Jiang Zhixia smiled politely: "Pay me back! I remember that you lent me more than one million gold coins in total, as well as the clothes and jewelry you borrowed temporarily every time. You also know that I never use things that others have used, so give me a discount for them. "
She lowered her head to calculate, then raised her head to smile even brighter, "A total of 3.6 million gold coins~"
Zeng Wenwen pointed at herself in disbelief and stuttered, "Princess, I am your friend! "
When Jiang Zhixia heard this, her expression was even more exaggerated than hers: "Didn't we break off our relationship? Besides, my friend doesn’t have to pay back the money? "
Zeng Wenwen's face turned blue and white.
She finally realized that Jiang Zhixia had really changed.
But why? ! It was obviously fine a few days ago!
She turned her head suddenly and glared at Lu Jue fiercely.
Is it because of him? !
She pointed at Lu Jue and said in a sharp voice, "Princess! Has this scumbag seduced you? ! You are a princess! How can you listen to a slave? ! "
Jiang Zhixia's smile faded and her face turned cold.
Lu Jue raised his eyes and looked at her fiercely.
Zeng Wenwen was startled by the hostility in the other party's eyes.
This sin slave still dares to harm her? !
Jiang Zhixia's tone became colder, "Zeng Wenwen, please show some respect to him, otherwise I won't just ask you to pay back the money. "
After she finished speaking, she noticed Zeng Wenwen's horrified expression and subconsciously turned around.
Lu Jue stood behind her obediently and looked up at her innocently, his eyes filled with confusion.
Jiang Zhixia became even more angry.
These two bitches scolded each other with vile and filthy words whenever they met!
How old is the child? What should I do if it leaves a psychological shadow? !
She turned back fiercely: "Pay back the money! If you don't pay it back, I will ask my eldest brother to go to Zeng's house in person. Anyway, eldest brother is in the palace now. It's just a word from me. "
Zeng Wenwen's face turned a little whiter.
If Jiang Ting takes action... the Zeng family will be doomed!
She took out the bare brain with shaking hands and said with difficulty: "I, I don't have so much now, only these..."
"Ding——"
Jiang Zhixia looked at his head and received one million gold coins.
Zeng Wenwen still looked as arrogant as before. She begged for mercy with red eyes: "I saved this for a long time, and the rest..."
She wanted to say, "Forget the rest. The princess is definitely not short of this little money."
Jiang Zhixia happily accepted the payment and responded to her: "Yeah, the remaining installments are fine, but I only give you one month. If you don't make enough, I won't be polite." "Zeng Wenwen turned pale and shut up.
Jiang Zhixia got the money and raised her hand: "Okay, you can go."
Zeng Wenwen was so angry that she wiped her tears and ran away.
How dare she stay?
When they left, Jiang Zhixia sat on the sofa with her feet up and smiled.
"Hahaha, it's so cool!" It's great to be a princess!
Lu Jue came over and squatted down beside her.
"Princess...has she chosen a real husband?"
